subject: Suspense entity netting and revenue recognition ladder
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@celeritycloud.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@celeritycloud.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspense entity netting and revenue recognition ladder

Hi Maria,

Thanks for sending the payment extracts last week. We pulled the AP exports and there are ~7 payments sitting in our suspense entity (SUS-RECV) that look like netted credits from your side — total ~USD 48,972. Before we post anything to AR or release credits against open invoices, we need to confirm two things so we can map to revenue recognition correctly:

1) Are those netted items you see an explicit credit (customer-level) applied on your end, or are they settlement adjustments that should be recorded as contra-revenue (we need GL treatment)?
2) For the credits tied to invoice series CC-INV-2025-*, can you confirm the underlying invoices were originally recognized on the monthly revenue ladder (SaaS recognized monthly) or posted as up-front? We want to avoid double-counting when we reclass the suspense balance.

I attached the AP extract (AP_record_0915.csv) with the rows highlighted we think map to SUS-RECV. If you can confirm the two items above by EOD Friday, we’ll assemble a proposed set of journal entries and a short rollback plan in case anything needs to be reversed.

Quick ask: if possible include the remittance ID/settlement reference for the three largest rows (IDs 8812, 8820, 8825) — that'll speed reconciliation.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: AP_record_0915.csv (CSV, 46 KB)

From: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@celeritycloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Suspense entity netting and revenue recognition ladder

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the note and the highlighted extract. Quick answers below:

1) The three large items (8812, 8820, 8825) were settlement nettings applied at the processor level to offset chargebacks in August. They are not customer credits initiated by our AR team — treat them as settlement adjustments.

2) The invoices in CC-INV-2025-* were recognized monthly (subscription revenue, prorated monthly). None were accelerated recognition on our side.

I’ve attached our remittance confirmation for 8812/8820/8825. We don’t have a separate remittance ID for the smaller rows — those are minor fee reversals from our PSP.

Let me know if you want to hop on a short call to walk the two largest items.

Best,
Maria
Senior AR Specialist, CelerityCloud
maria.gutierrez@celeritycloud.com
Attachment: celerity_remit_8812-8825.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Suspense entity netting and revenue recognition ladder

Laura / Rishi — forwarding Maria's confirmation. High-level thoughts:

- If Maria confirms those are settlement nettings (not customer-initiated credits), we should post them as contra-revenue or a settlement loss GL (not reduce AR against the open invoices). That keeps invoice-level AR intact so renewals / collections are unaffected.
- Proposed action: create two JEs — (A) move SUS-RECV -> ContraRevenue (account 4205) for the total $48,972, split by currency and entity; (B) create a balancing JE to clear any FX differences to FX Gain/Loss.
- For any rows that already had a linked remittance that matched an invoice payment (small handful), we can apply those against invoices and exclude from the netting JE.

I put together a draft workbook with the mapping and a suggested journal set — attached (proposed_journal_entries_20261006.xlsx). Rishi, can you sanity-check the ledger accounts and the rollback steps? If we proceed, we should also update the revenue recognition mapping table so those settlement rows don't trigger a revenue reversal in the next month’s close.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_journal_entries_20261006.xlsx (XLSX, 72 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@celeritycloud.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspense entity netting and revenue recognition ladder

Laura / Maria / Grace — reviewed the draft and ran it against last quarter's close:

- Ledger accounts: 4205 (ContraRevenue) + 6501 (Settlement Fees) + 6402 (FX Gain/Loss) look correct. For entities with intercompany flows, we should include a clearing entry to IC Suspense so we don't distort intercompany AR.
- Journal lines: I adjusted the split for 8820 — there is a USD/EUR mix that requires two lines (USD 27,400; EUR equivalent posted to 4205 local). See attached PDF netting-schedule-10-07.pdf for the adjusted amounts.
- Rollback plan: create reversing JE dated 30 days from the posting date, reference JVs with tag NET-2026-10-CEL. If any of the settlement amounts are later reclassified by Celerity, we'll reverse and reapply as true customer credit.

Maria — if you can confirm final confirmations for the small fee reversals (rows under $250 each) by EOD tomorrow, Laura and I will prepare the JVs and request posting for Oct 10 close window.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: netting-schedule-10-07.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@celeritycloud.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspense entity netting and revenue recognition ladder — plan and next steps

Maria — thanks again for the confirmations. Per Rishi’s adjustments, we’ll proceed with the following plan:

1) Post JE NET-2026-10-CEL on Oct 10: move SUS-RECV -> ContraRevenue 4205 (USD 48,972 split per attached netting schedule).
2) Post FX balancing lines to 6402 as required by entity currency split.
3) Apply any clearly matched remittances to invoices (small rows) instead of including in the netting JE.
4) Post reversing JE on Nov 9 (30-day reversal) so we can quickly reclass if Celerity asks for customer credit reapplication.

I’ll open the AR ticket requesting the posting window and include the JE support workbook. Grace, Rishi — please add any internal GL tags and the Jira key FIN-7623 to the posting memo. Maria, once you confirm the sub-$250 items by tomorrow EOD we are green. Also booking a 30-minute call for Friday 10/9 10:00 PT to walk through for transparency — invite sent.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
